description: Neutron (network) command surface served by lightstack — SPEC-028 tier A/B conformance. Verified against python-openstackclient 7.0.0 (openstacksdk 4.21.0, osc-lib 4.7.0). Lifecycle entries cover the full CRUD of their resource in one case (the volume.transfer.request precedent) to keep the standalone suite inside its runtime budget. Excluded with reason: 'address group' (GET /v2.0/address-groups answers 404 — no route in internal/neutron), 'network flavor' (GET /v2.0/flavors answers 404 — no route), 'floating ip show' (OSC 7.0.0 passes a plain-callable port_details formatter that osc-lib 4.7.0 rejects — every invocation exits 1 with 'Invalid formatter provided.' before the response is rendered, reproducible against any Neutron; lightstack's GET /v2.0/floatingips/{id} itself answers 200 with the full body), 'network rbac set' (openstacksdk 4.21.0 crashes client-side with 'Resource.get() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given' before any request; the served PUT /v2.0/rbac-policies/{id} also binds only the legacy target_tenant field, not target_project_id), and 'network agent show' (this deployment registers no agents, so GET /v2.0/agents/{id} has nothing to serve — only the list is covered). 'address scope' commands are served by the server but are not covered in this wave (runtime budget; their by-name GET still answers 500 instead of 404 — the uuid-guard pattern applied to ports and subnet pools has not been extended to them). Every divergence this suite recorded as known-failing on its first run has since been fixed in the server; the probes remain in suites/network.sh as plain assertions of the fixed behaviour.

commands.cmd: openstack network create <name> (case also covers network list + delete of the created network)
openstack subnet create --network <network> --subnet-range <cidr> <name> (case also covers subnet list/show/delete)
openstack subnet delete <subnet> (tier B only: deletion while a router interface holds the subnet)
openstack port create --network <network> <name> (case also covers port list/show/delete)
openstack router create <name> (case also covers router list/show/delete)
openstack router add subnet <router> <subnet> / openstack router remove subnet <router> <subnet>
openstack router set --external-gateway <network> <router> / openstack router unset --external-gateway <router>
openstack security group create <name> (case also covers security group list/show/delete)
openstack security group rule create --proto tcp --dst-port <port> <group> (case also covers security group rule list/delete)
openstack floating ip create <network> (case also covers floating ip list/delete)
openstack floating ip set --port <port> / openstack floating ip unset --port <floating-ip>
openstack subnet pool create --pool-prefix <cidr> <name> (case also covers subnet pool list/show/delete)
openstack network rbac create --type network --target-project <project> --action access_as_shared <network> (case also covers network rbac list/show/delete)
